parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of same-sex conduct since 2005 and no trans-specific offence is documented. The Gender Equality Act 2019, in force, prohibits gender-identity discrimination across all areas and includes judicial/law-enforcement sensitisation, with a Code of Judicial Conduct; a 2015 report recorded no LGBT-specific abuses and an openly LGBTIQ initiative operates. That is a positive structural signal. However, the dossier documents no enforcement outcomes, facility or ward access, border/document-marker practice, custody placement, or broad social acceptance beyond one initiative, and its violence evidence is dated. Those are open questions, not known exposures, but paper protections without shown operation cannot support the 0.85 tier. Resident-only marriage denial is not counted against a visitor.
